blockingFindings.scope: Whole main case A: required multiple actual creature types and nonmatching control
blockingFindings.missing: Current demonstrated Water Pet profiles explicitly supply Elemental. The inspected current ordinary summon operational profiles and current AC4 sources did not establish a second concrete typed actor for this required control. Human ancestry, Spectral Steed, spell school, native plane and visual appearance do not supply that missing classification. This is not a claim that no qualifying source exists elsewhere.
blockingFindings.minimalCorrection: Bind an exact currently accepted complete non-Elemental creature profile and its real acquired actor route, then demonstrate matching ally/enemy and actual nonmatching crossings, without importing native-plane or CR facts.

blockingFindings.scope: Required automatic-guard and whole occupied-cell lifecycle witnesses
blockingFindings.missing: The two positive Elemental admissions are recorded, but the rule-only touch/type-change/already-claimed entries contain no concrete qualifying state transition. Separate living carried-body admission, primary escape, dead-primary/corpse handling and finite-summon expiry with real loose cargo are not demonstrated. An integrity pass cannot promote those entries.
blockingFindings.minimalCorrection: Complete the exact stated preconditions and acquired independent escape/ending sources; trace actual approach/crossing, guard contention and each body/cargo lifecycle through independent cell closure. Retain unavailable typed/corpse prerequisites as narrow holds. No default teleport, invented corpse or separate-creature-as-equipment shortcut.
